concept.hr: Isti niz: TCP šalje ponovno i zastaje, UDP gubi i nastavlja
concept.en: The same stream: TCP retransmits and stalls, UDP drops and continues

summary.hr: Isti podaci i isti gubici, jedno uz drugo: TCP čeka ponovni prijenos pa predaje sve, pravim redoslijedom; UDP predaje što stigne, bez zastoja.
summary.en: The same data and the same losses, side by side: TCP waits for the resend and then delivers everything in order; UDP delivers what arrives, without a stall.
